Package com.github.crittscott.somestacks.gametest

Class ItemOpsChecks

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somestacks.gametest.ItemOpsChecks
public final class ItemOpsChecks extends Object
The shared item helpers, exercised against real registry items: what a hand will accept, what a merge moves and reports, empty-handler detection, and the per-slot light contribution and its cap.

  • Method Details

    • handCompatibilityUsesExactItemTagsAndCapacity

      public static void handCompatibilityUsesExactItemTagsAndCapacity(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Internal hand-compatibility check: reject empty offers, full hands, different items, and different NBT; accept matching stone below capacity and an empty hand.

      To check manually, store stone and plain-right-click it with an empty hand, 63 stone, 64 stone, dirt, then differently tagged stone. Only empty or matching hands with space can extract.

    • mergeReturnsMovedCountAndDoesNotShrinkIncoming

      public static void mergeReturnsMovedCountAndDoesNotShrinkIncoming(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Internal merge contract with no direct manual reproduction: merge a ten-stone offer into 60 stone, asserting a moved count of four, a full destination, and an unchanged source count of ten.

      Nearest visible check: extract stored stone while holding 60 matching stone; the hand fills to 64 and the untransferred contents remain stored.

    • mergeRejectsDifferentItemsAndTags

      public static void mergeRejectsDifferentItemsAndTags(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Internal merge check: different item types and different NBT variants return zero moved items.

      To check manually, store tagged stone, then attempt plain-click extraction while holding dirt or stone with different custom NBT. Neither hand nor contents should change.

    • handlerEmptyDetectionScansEverySlot

      public static void handlerEmptyDetectionScansEverySlot(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Internal empty-detection check with no direct manual reproduction: a three-slot inventory is empty until its final slot receives stone.

      Nearest visible check: extract the last occupied item from a temporary Storage pile; it should disappear after settlement regardless of the item's former slot.

    • lightIsPerOccupiedSlotIntegerDividedAndCapped

      public static void lightIsPerOccupiedSlotIntegerDividedAndCapped(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Internal light calculation: one slot with 64 glowstone contributes 3; six occupied glowstone slots cap the result at 15.

      To check manually, place glowstone in one Singles cell, inspect the block light, then occupy five additional cells. Light rises per occupied cell and stops at 15; adding count to a single Storage slot does not increase its contribution.
